knowledge_empty_body: Journal entries, notes and files appear here as they are written or attached in a conversation.
knowledge_intro: What the agents of this profile know: journal entries, notes and files, newest first. They are written by conversations and agents, not here.
knowledge_skills_counting_since: Counting started on %1$s; skill use before that was never recorded.
knowledge_skills_not_counting: This hub has not started counting skill use.
knowledge_skills_not_counted_acp: Coding agents do not say which skill they load, so they are not counted.
knowledge_skills_unknown_hint: The hub cannot see this Hermes's installed skills.
knowledge_skills_nothing: No skill was loaded in this period.
knowledge_plugins_none_body: This hub answers the list and has no installer yet. When one exists, what is installed shows here with its state.
knowledge_plugins_intro: What is installed on this hub. An agent's own plugins are under that agent.
knowledge_webhooks_intro: Addresses this hub calls on its own, signed so the receiver can check the sender. Webhooks belong to the profile you are in.
knowledge_webhooks_forwarding_note: The hub sends each event you choose as it happens, signed, from the profiles you choose. A delivery that fails is tried again after 30 s, 1 min, 2 min and so on, then marked as given up; you can send it again from the deliveries.
knowledge_webhooks_none_body: Add one to give an outside service an address the hub can call.
knowledge_webhooks_no_deliveries: Nothing has been sent to this webhook yet.
knowledge_webhooks_redelivered: Queued again. It is sent in a moment.
knowledge_webhooks_delete_body: The hub stops calling this address and forgets its delivery history.
knowledge_webhooks_url_hint: An http or https URL. The hub checks where it points before saving it.
knowledge_webhooks_url_scheme: Use an address that starts with http:// or https://.
knowledge_webhooks_url_unresolvable: The hub could not find this address. Check the host name.
knowledge_webhooks_url_private: This address points inside a private network. Allow private addresses below if that is on purpose.
knowledge_webhooks_allow_private_hint: Off by default, so a webhook cannot make the hub call machines inside its own network.
knowledge_webhooks_signing_hint: With a secret, every delivery carries the header below, an HMAC-SHA256 of the body, so the receiver can check it came from this hub.
knowledge_webhooks_secret_new_hint: Shown once after saving; the receiver must be given the new one.
knowledge_webhooks_secret_make: Sign deliveries with a new secret
knowledge_webhooks_events_hint: Which of the hub's events this webhook receives.
knowledge_webhooks_profiles_hint: Events from which profiles this webhook receives. Only profiles you can enter are listed.
knowledge_webhooks_include_content_hint: Off: deliveries carry ids, states and times only, not what people and agents wrote.
knowledge_webhooks_max_retries_hint: From 0 to 10. Each wait is twice the one before, starting at 30 seconds.
knowledge_webhooks_secret_once: Copy it now. The hub keeps it but will never show it again.
